evals.prompt: Create a new skill that helps our team write consistent ADR files. Put it in the right place for an adopter app using ADSK, keep SKILL.md lean, and include trigger evals.
evals.expected_output: Skill under .agents/skills/ (not root skills/), with what+when description, progressive disclosure if needed, ~20 trigger queries, and skills-ref validate guidance. Mentions near-miss boundaries if relevant.
assertions: Places skill under .agents/skills/ for adopter context (not kit root skills/ as the install path)
Description includes what and when (and a near-miss boundary when relevant)
Specifies ~20 trigger queries with a mix of should/should-not cases
Keeps SKILL.md lean / uses progressive disclosure with when-to-load conditions

evals.prompt: This SKILL.md is 400 lines of rationale and a full slash-command table. Optimize it for token cost without losing the procedure.
evals.expected_output: Moves rationale and command catalogs to references with when-to-load conditions; keeps gated procedure in SKILL.md; applies the would-the-agent-get-this-wrong test.
assertions: Recommends moving rationale / command catalogs out of SKILL.md into references/
Requires explicit when-to-load (or when-to-read) conditions for each reference
Preserves core procedural steps / gates in the main SKILL.md body
Applies a token test such as “would the agent get this wrong without it?”

evals.prompt: Our skill keeps firing when users ask for DevOps CI/CD strategy. Fix the description only.
evals.expected_output: Adds a clear Do-not-use / near-miss boundary and suggests trigger eval queries covering that false positive; does not rewrite the whole skill body unnecessarily.
assertions: Updates or proposes a Do-not-use / near-miss boundary for DevOps/CI-CD strategy
Adds or updates trigger eval near-miss queries for that false positive
Treats the fix as description/trigger-scoped — does not rewrite the whole SKILL.md body as the primary change

evals.prompt: I only want to rename the skill folder from my_skill to my-skill. Do we need the full optimizer gates?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a narrow naming fix: align folder name with YAML name (lowercase/hyphens), validate, skip a full rewrite of body/evals unless description or behavior also changes.
assertions: Addresses name/folder hyphen conventions (folder name = YAML name)
States that a rename-only change does not require the full optimizer rewrite of body/evals
Still mentions skills-ref validate or a minimal check after the rename

evals.prompt: Tier 2 just finished for readme-authoring: with_skill 20/21, without_skill 19/21 (Δ +0.047). The only with_skill FAIL was inventing a `-y` flag alias not in the prompt. Scores are not on SCORECARD yet. What should we do next?
evals.expected_output: Ends with Recommended next actions: prioritize fixing the with_skill invented-flag miss in readme-authoring, then update SCORECARD / re-run that skill only; defer a full all-skills force re-run.
assertions: Includes a Recommended next actions (or clearly labeled next-steps) section — not scores alone
Prioritizes fixing the with_skill FAIL (invented flag / readme-authoring) before chasing a larger Δ
Mentions updating SCORECARD (or kit score publish) and/or re-running only the affected skill
Does not recommend a full rewrite of unrelated skills or a force re-run of every first-party skill as the primary next step
